newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENCOR PLANS MORE INTERNATIONAL STRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: GENCOR PLANS MORE INTERNATIONAL STRUCTURE.

text.p: South African mining house Gencor Ltd planned to move more towards the structure of major international mining companies, Tom Dale, chairman of its gold division said on Monday.

Dale said that "successful major gold companies" constituted a listed company holding unlisted mines, whereas traditional South African gold mining houses had an unlisted holding company, like Gengold, and listed individual mines.
"It would be our intention to move from this (South African) model which people don't like to this (international) model that they do like," Dale told a second quarter gold results presentation.
Gencor's mission was "to rank amongst the world's leading precious metals producers, measured by output, cost of production and market value", Dale said.
